data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 reduces to SRC_002: the external market signal synchronization mechanism is a specific economic instance of the de facto monoculture constraint, where the shared cause (optimization metric) forces independent operators into identical failure modes. Refuted if small operators optimize for orthogonal, non-market metrics (e.g., local physical constraints) that desynchronize their scaling thresholds regardless of shared market signals.
